# Qingdao L-Guard Chemical Co., Ltd.

> > Leading China-based manufacturer of personal protective equipment (PPE) including nitrile gloves, disposable gloves, face masks (KN95/FFP2/FFP3), and safety equipment.

Qingdao L-Guard Chemical Co., Ltd., based in Shandong, China, is an ISO 9001, ISO13485, and ISO14001 certified manufacturer specializing in work gloves, safety gloves, cleaning gloves, respiratory protection masks, and other PPE products for industrial, medical, and hospitality applications.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile Gloves
- Disposable Gloves
- KN95 Mask
- FFP2 Mask
- FFP3 Mask
- PE Gloves
- Vinyl Gloves
- Safety Gloves
- PPE Products
- Respiratory Masks
- ISO 9001 Certified
- ISO13485 Certified
- China Manufacturer
- Qingdao L-Guard Chemical Co., Ltd.
- Protective Equipment
